description: Adjusted Rand Index: how well the Leiden clusters, one per cell type, match the cell-type labels. About 0 = random, 1 = identical, higher = better.
Normalized Mutual Information: how much the Leiden clusters, one per cell type, tell about the cell-type labels. 0-1, higher = better.
Average silhouette width: how well the Leiden clusters, one per cell type, separate from each other on the embedding. Rescaled to 0-1, higher = better.

Isolated-label silhouette: each cell's silhouette (distance to the nearest other Leiden cluster), averaged per cluster and then over the clusters. Every cluster is treated as an isolated label, where scib's default counts only labels found in few batches. 0-1, higher = better.

Isolated-label F1: how well one Leiden cluster captures each cell type, the best F1 of one cluster (one cluster per cell type), averaged over the cell types. Every cell type is treated as an isolated label, where scib's default counts only types found in few batches. 0-1, higher = better.
Cell-type LISI: how much each cell's neighbours share its cell type on the embedding, the median over cells, scaled to 0-1, higher = better.
Batch silhouette: how well the batches mix within each cell type, 1 minus the absolute batch silhouette within each cell type, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
Batch ARI: how little the Leiden clusters, one per batch, match the batches, 1 minus their absolute Adjusted Rand Index. 0-1, higher = better.
Batch NMI: how little the Leiden clusters, one per batch, tell about the batches, 1 minus their Normalized Mutual Information. 0-1, higher = better.

Graph connectivity: how much of each cell type stays in one connected group of neighbours, the share of its cells in the largest connected part of its neighbour graph, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
Integration LISI: how many batches appear among each cell's neighbours on the embedding, the median over cells, scaled to 0-1, higher = better.
k-nearest-neighbour batch effect test: how often a neighbourhood holds the overall batch mix, 1 minus the rate at which the test rejects that mix, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
Overall classification accuracy: the fraction of query cells predicted correctly. 0-1, higher = better.
Average classification accuracy: the fraction of each cell type predicted correctly, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
Specificity, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
Sensitivity, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
F1-score, averaged over the cell types. 0-1, higher = better.
